title: summary.native data
description: An engine's own first-order summary of a case: per requested line, the values it states under the contract's definitions, each a number or null where it states none. Code checks that an unavailable line says why and states no value, and that every value an ok line states is a finite number.

lines.description: One entry per requested line, in the order of the request.

line.description: The line, as it was requested.

wavelengthNm.description: The wavelength the engine's summary is of.

status.description: ok: the engine stands by the values it states. unavailable: it states none, and says why.

reason.description: The engine's own code for why the line is not ok; always there for a line that is not.

rearFocalZ.description: z of the paraxial rear focal point in the contract frame, mm: what identifies the system the answer is of. Null where the engine states none.

focalLengthMm.description: The effective focal length the answer's f-numbers are formed with, mm; null where the engine states none.

entrancePupilDiameterMm.description: The diameter of the entrance pupil as the engine presents it, mm; null where it states none.

stopDiameterMm.description: The clear diameter of the stop the answer is of, mm; null where the engine states none.

imageSpaceFNumber.description: The magnitude of the focal length over the entrance pupil's diameter, whatever the object's distance (OpticStudio's image-space F/#); null where the engine states none.

paraxialWorkingFNumber.description: 1 / (2 n' |u'|), u' the image-space slope of the paraxial marginal ray of the case's axial object point and n' the image space's index (OpticStudio's paraxial working F/#); null where the engine states none.

workingFNumber.description: 1 / (2 n' sin t'), t' the angle of the real marginal ray of the case's axial object point to its chief ray in image space (OpticStudio's working F/#); null where the engine states none.

nominalFNumber.description: The f-number the engine marks the aperture with, which is not computed from the system; null where it marks none.

totalTrackMm.description: The image plane's z less the first vertex's, mm; null where the engine states none.

halfFieldDeg.description: The half field the engine assigns the system, degrees; null where it assigns none.

sampling.description: What else the engine states of the line, by names of its own.

method.description: The engine's own name for how it computed the answer, and the settings it computed with.

notes.description: What the engine says about the answer, for people.
